picks.why: 異動：價格站上真實市場均價（cross:above_tmm:on），今日發現 2026-11-04-1 的起點
picks.zh:
收盤由 $77,332 跳到 $80,441，站回真實市場均價 $77,627 之上；下方的短期持有者成本在 $75,961。上週在這兩條線之間接手的人，現在都在獲利。
#比特幣 #BTC #鏈上數據
picks.en:
The close jumped from $77,332 to $80,441, back above the true market mean at $77,627; the STH cost basis sits below at $75,961. Those who bought between the two lines last week are now in profit.
#Bitcoin #BTC #onchain

picks.why: 今日發現 2026-11-04-1：76K 新籌碼轉為獲利，84K 是上方供給
picks.zh:
短期持有者 371.3 萬顆、平均成本 $75,292，最厚一格在 76–78K（65.1 萬顆，CheckOnChain，11/04）。收盤在這一格上方，這批籌碼由虧轉盈；收盤上方最厚的長期持有者籌碼在 84K。
#比特幣 #BTC #鏈上數據
picks.en:
Short-term holders hold 3.71M BTC at an average cost of $75,292, thickest at 76–78K (651K BTC, CheckOnChain, Nov 4). The close is above that bucket, so it flipped from loss to profit; the thickest LTH supply above the close sits at 84K.
#Bitcoin #BTC #onchain

picks.why: 今日發現 2026-11-04-2：大漲那天美元現貨仍在折價
picks.zh:
價格一天漲 4%，Coinbase 溢價還是負的：最新一天 −0.094%、7 日平均 −0.187%、30 日平均 −0.132%。美國現貨價格仍低於幣安，推上去的不是美元買盤。
#比特幣 #BTC #資金流
picks.en:
Price rose 4% in a day, yet the Coinbase premium stayed negative: −0.094% on the latest day, −0.187% on a 7-day average, −0.132% over 30 days. US spot still trades below Binance; dollar buyers did not drive this.
#Bitcoin #BTC #flows
